title: Marine mammal sex determination using epidermal tissue from suction-cup tags
author: Sadie Novak
materials: DNA extraction was performed with a commercially available kit (DNease Blood & Tissue Kit, Qiagen, cat. no. 69504). To begin DNA extraction, remove swab tip from plastic stick. This can be done by tracing a clean razor blade along the connection point from the swab tip to the swab stick. Transfer the swab tip to a clean 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tube for each sample. Be sure to use a clean razor blade for each sample to avoid cross-contamination of any genetic material.

The PCR product will be assessed by gel electrophoresis using the known length of the SRY (332 bpd), ZFX (245), and ZFY (212). This protocol is written for use with an EasyCast B1 Mini Gel Electrophoresis system (ThermoFisher).

Once the gel run is complete, resolved DNA fragments may be visualized with a UV transilluminator. In this protocol, a ChemiDoc imaging system (Bio-Rad) was used to image the resolved PCR products following separation by gel electrophoresis. The blue tray and the protocol pre-programmed in the instrument for use with SYBR Safe DNA stain was used.

PCR amplification was performed with OneTaq DNA polymerase (New England BioLabs, cat. no. M0480S) and the standard reaction buffer supplied with the enzyme. PCR amplification was performed on extracted DNA samples using primers specific to the SRY (sex-determining region Y) and ZFX/ZFY (sex chromosomal zing-finger) genes. Oligonucleotide primers for both of these genes have been validated in other species (Bérubé et al., 1996; Suárez-Menéndez et al., 2024). Primers were ordered from IDT DNA. Forward SRY: 5' TGT GAA CGG TGA GGA TTA 3' Reverse SRY: 5' GTG CAT GGC TCG TAG TCT 3' Forward ZFX: 5’ ATA GGT CTG CAG ACT CTT CTA 3’ Reverse ZFX: 5’ CAC TTA TGG GGG TAG TCC TTT 3’ Primers updated 5/29/2025. These primers yield better results for baleen whales compared to Version 1. This also provides two confirmations of males (SRY and ZFY). PCR conditions and bpd are adjusted accordingly. Martine Bérubé and Per Jakob Palsbøll. steps.title: Collect Epidermal Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Retrieve the tag from the water using a net, wearing gloves to prevent contamination. Ensure nothing else touches the suction cups.

substeps.instruction: Using fresh nitrile gloves, wipe the inside of the suction cups with a sterile swab, avoiding the outside of the cup and other tag parts.
Swab two suction cups with one swab, then the other two suction cups with a new sterile swab to ensure sample security.

steps.title: Store and Label Samples
steps.instruction: Secure the swabs in plastic vials and document the collection metadata.

substeps.instruction: Place the swab tip first into a plastic vial, trimming the handle if necessary to close the lid.
Label the vial with the date and identifying information (e.g., 'bb22_115a' for species ID, julian day, and deployment order).
Record the date, time, location (latitude/longitude), and group size/proximity to other animals on a datasheet.
Immediately move vials to a -80 °C freezer; if unavailable, store on dry ice.

steps.title: Extract Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Perform DNA extraction using the DNeasy Mini kit protocol.

substeps.instruction: Add 180 µL of Buffer ATL directly to each tube containing a swab; pipette up and down over the swab at least 20 times.
Add 20 µL of Proteinase K, pipette to mix, and vortex on high for 15 seconds.
Incubate samples at 56 °C in a hot water bath for 3 hours.
Add 200 µL of Buffer AL and vortex for 15 seconds; immediately add 200 µL of 96% (v/v) EtOH and vortex for 15 seconds.
Pipette solution into a DNeasy Mini spin column in a 2 mL collection tube; incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, then centrifuge at 6000 x g for 5 minutes.
Discard flowthrough and collection tube; place column in a clean 2 mL collection tube (do not discard flowthrough into bleach).
Add 500 µL of Buffer AW1 and centrifuge at 6000 x g for 5 minutes; discard flowthrough and collection tube, then place column in a clean 2 mL collection tube.
Add 500 µL of Buffer AW2 and centrifuge at 17000 x g for 3 minutes to dry the membrane; discard flowthrough and collection tube, then place column in a clean 2 mL collection tube.
If the column bottom touched flowthrough, repeat the 17000 x g centrifugation for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Elute and Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Recover the DNA from the spin column and determine its concentration.

substeps.instruction: Place the dried column in a clean 1.5 mL eppendorf tube and apply 100 µL Buffer AE to the center of the membrane (do not touch membrane with tip).
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, then centrifuge at 6000 x g for 1 minute.
Repeat elution by applying another 100 µL Buffer AE and centrifuging at 6000 x g for 1 minute (or perform a single 200 µL elution).
Dry DNA samples in a speed vac overnight at room temperature.
Re-solubilize DNA in 20 µL of ultrapure water.
Measure concentration (ng/uL) and purity (260/280) using a Nanodrop.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up the reaction mixture in 0.2 mL PCR-grade tubes for each sample.

substeps.instruction: Combine the following reagents: DNA Template (2 µL), Forward SRY Primer 20µM (0.5 µL), Reverse SRY Primer 20µM (0.5 µL), Forward ZFX/ZFY Primer 20µM (0.5 µL), Reverse ZFX/ZFY Primer 20µM (0.5 µL), MyTaq HS Red Mix 2x (12.5 µL), and Water dH2O (8.5 µL).
If increasing template DNA volume for band intensity, subtract the equivalent volume from the dH2O to maintain a final volume of 25 µL.

steps.title: Amplify DNA via PCR
steps.instruction: Run 30 cycles of PCR using the following thermal conditions:

substeps.instruction: Initial Denaturation: 95 °C for 3 min (1 cycle)
Denaturation: 95 °C for 15 sec (35 cycles)
Annealing: 55 °C for 15 sec (35 cycles)
Extension: 72 °C for 20 sec (35 cycles)

steps.title: Prepare Agarose Gel
steps.instruction: Cast a 2% agarose gel for electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 2% agarose solution (e.g., 1.875 g agarose in 75 mL 1X TAE buffer).
Melt agarose in a microwave in 15-30 second increments, swirling between heatings.
Cool at room temperature for 5 minutes, then add SYBR Safe dye to reach 1X concentration (e.g., 7.5 µL of 10,000X dye for 75 mL solution).
Place gel tray in the buffer chamber, using a level to ensure it is even and gaskets seal the walls.
Cast the stained solution immediately and place a comb in the mold.
Allow to polymerize at room temperature for 20 minutes under dark conditions.

steps.title: Run Gel Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Separate the PCR products and analyze the bands.

substeps.instruction: Dilute PCR products by adding 4 µL of 6X xylene cyanol solution to reach a final concentration of 1X.
Remove the comb and fill the buffer chamber with 1X TAE buffer until the gel is submerged.
Load 2.5 µL of 100 bp DNA molecular weight marker (NEB#B7025) with 1X bromophenol blue into the first well.
Load 10 µL of each sample into the subsequent wells.
Run the gel at 140 V under dark conditions.
Monitor the run until the bromophenol blue dye has migrated ~1 cm from the midpoint (approx. 35-45 minutes).
